usage: The word '洗衫' functions as a verb phrase meaning 'to wash clothes'.
It is commonly used in daily conversations about household chores.
You can use '洗衫' with time expressions to indicate when you wash clothes, e.g., '今日我要洗衫' (I need to wash clothes today).
'洗衫' can also be combined with other verbs for emphasis, like '返嚟先洗衫' (wash clothes after coming back).
It is often used in imperative sentences to remind or request someone to do the laundry.
